title: Roach task record
description: One file per task under .agent/tasks/T###.json. Authored fields may be written by a worker; coordinator fields are written by scripts/roach.py and should not be edited by hand.

id.description: Stable task id. Must match the file name.

kind.description: discovery, planning, research, design, implementation, verification, product-feedback, or a project-specific lowercase token.

status.description: claimed/active/verify require a claim; every other status forbids one.

depends_on.description: Prerequisite task ids. Must exist, must not self-reference, must not be cancelled while this task is live, and must not form a cycle.

areas.description: Coarse collision hints. A task is not eligible while another live claim shares an area.

requirements.description: Ids from the active Requirements section of .agent/PRODUCT.md. Terminal tasks may retain retired ids; live work may not.

requires.description: Hard capability gate. A worker without all of these must not claim the task.

prefers.description: Soft preference. Improves ranking; never excludes.

acceptance.description: Observable conditions that mean the task is done. Required for every non-cancelled task.

verify.description: Optional executable check for this task. A string runs through the platform shell; an array runs directly with no shell. Run by finish, which refuses when it fails.

verification.description: Free-form completion note, or the reason a cancelled task was retired. Required for terminal tasks. This is a claim by its author, not proof.

claim.description: Present exactly when status is claimed, active, or verify.

base_commit.description: Base branch HEAD when the claim was taken.

adopted_from.description: Previous owner, when this claim came from adopt.

adopted_reason.description: Why a live claim was overridden. Required with adopt --force.

handoff.description: Continuation context a successor cannot cheaply infer. Holds the blocker reason while status is blocked. Must be null on terminal tasks.

review_of.description: This verification task independently reviews that completed task. Requires kind: verification.

correction_of.description: This task corrects findings recorded by that completed task.

integration.description: Written by integrate. The durable link between a completed task and the work it produced.

evidence.description: Written by finish. How the repository knows work happened.

work.description: Human-readable summary of the evidence found.

commit.description: Base branch HEAD when the task was finished.
